Used in: cad/turret.py M2006 (gearbox Ø24.4 x 25, body 43.8 behind the front face plus a Ø6 x 4 rotor hub; the rear 17 mm is the

  Ø19 at 120 deg; wires leave radially 28.5-30.1 behind the front face), the feed timing (500 rpm no load, 1 N m at 416 rpm with
  the C610, 0.18 N m/A).
